relationships.subject: CLARIX FLO
relationships.evidence_quote: CLARIX FLO treatment effectively reversed the increase in TRPV1 mRNA after 1 and 4 weeks

relationships.subject: CLARIX FLO
relationships.evidence_quote: CLARIX FLO significantly reduced the TNF-α level in the first and fourth weeks post-adhesion but not in the eighth week

relationships.subject: CLARIX FLO
relationships.evidence_quote: the level of IL-10, an anti-inflammatory cytokine, was significantly increased at the fourth week post-surgery in the CLARIX FLO treatment group

relationships.subject: CLARIX FLO
relationships.evidence_quote: CLARIX FLO treatment significantly reversed the mechanical allodynia induced by the DRG adhesion surgery

relationships.subject: HHP
relationships.evidence_quote: HHP treatment also reversed the increase in TRPV1 and TNF-α mRNA expression at 24 h post-surgery

relationships.subject: CD44
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that CLARIX FLO/HHP suppresses TRPV1 through a CD44-dependent mechanism.

key_findings: CLARIX FLO and its component HHP relieve DRG adhesion-induced allodynia, lowering TNF-alpha and TRPV1 and shifting macrophages M1 to M2.
Anti-CD44 antibody reverses CLARIX FLO/HHP analgesia and TRPV1 suppression, implicating a CD44-TRPV1 pathway.
